answer: Sybils must acquire many scarce tokens through the narrow inlet of the registrar, whose issuance rate is capped by the meadow of bonded peers voting on real-world attestations. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted once per verified identity, then burn a fraction per epoch. Fabricating identities costs the full stake plus burned pigment, making mass sybil creation economically irrational when the per-identity cost exceeds any epoch reward. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
